message: Outdated Apache version vulnerable to path traversal and remote code execution.
action: Upgrade Apache immediately to version 2.4.51 or higher.
Upgrade OpenSSH to the latest stable release.
Audit FTP daemon and upgrade to a secure, patched version of vsftpd.

message: Outdated Nginx web server version detected.
action: Upgrade Nginx to the latest stable release to patch known security flaws.

message: Potentially vulnerable or exposed Redis server version detected.
action: Ensure Redis requires authentication (requirepass) and is not exposed directly to the public internet.

message: End-of-life or legacy MySQL version detected.
action: Upgrade MySQL to version 8.0 or higher.

message: Unauthenticated or exposed Docker Remote API detected.
action: Restrict Docker socket access and protect port 2375/2376 with TLS or authentication.

message: Unprotected Elasticsearch instance exposed to reconnaissance.
action: Enable X-Pack security, require authentication, and bind to localhost/internal networks only.
Disable Telnet immediately and migrate entirely to SSH.

message: Unauthenticated Redis caching service exposed to the network.
action: Enable requirepass configuration, bind to localhost, and disable dangerous commands.
Place behind a reverse proxy with strict authentication and disable anonymous read access.
Restrict manager app access to trusted IP ranges and enforce strong credentials.

message: Potentially vulnerable vsFTPd 2.3.4 backdoor signature detected.
action: Upgrade FTP server software immediately to a patched, secure version.

message: Exposed Kubernetes Kubelet node API endpoint detected.
action: Secure Kubelet port 10250 with mutual TLS and Webhook token authentication.
